summary: Sidebar monitor drawers open at a compact height of at most 240px while keeping user-chosen sizes. Usage tables show readable account names and word headers; narrow views keep the all-windows count visible and fold the next window into that count. Full names and evidence remain available by keyboard and on hover. Charts show a body placeholder while loading and inset their supporting facts by 8px.

compatibility.detail: Existing saved monitor heights are preserved; resetting restores the compact default. Compact display captions now separate provider prefixes from account names so only the prefix shrinks first; all callers are migrated. Callbacks and persisted state are unchanged.
